Try the functions you selected. You can also continue and test them later.
Tap the text field and dictate a short sentence using the Diktuj keyboard. Press Stop and check the text.
Play a short Sorbian sample through Android’s Diktuj voice engine. Then check that you heard it. For reading in other apps, also try your Select to Speak shortcut.

Set up Sorbian speech input, speech output, or both.

To dictate, select the additional Diktuj keyboard. To read text aloud, use “Select to Speak” in Android accessibility settings, if available on your device.

An internet connection is required. Diktuj does not save microphone recordings.
Allow Diktuj to access the microphone for dictation. Read aloud works without this permission.
Enable the Diktuj keyboard in Android, then select it. In another app, tap a text field and use the microphone on this keyboard. The keyboard icon switches back to your usual keyboard.

Select Diktuj as the preferred text-to-speech engine. To read selected text in other apps, enable Select to Speak in Android accessibility settings, if available. Names and availability vary by device. You can choose and preview a voice on the Diktuj home screen.
Restore the packaged server addresses, voice and recognition options? Your last dictation will not be deleted.
